_description: Default detection thresholds. Runtime-tunable in the Python CLI via keyboard ([ ] , . ; ').

ear._note: EAR below threshold for drowsy_frames consecutive frames -> DROWSY. ~30 FPS -> ~1 sec.

head_pose._note: pitch > pitch_threshold (forward tilt, chin to chest) OR |roll| > roll_threshold (sideways slump) for bent_frames consecutive frames -> HEAD BENT.
